title: PSRR reduced C_eff x ESR characterization sweep manifest (Phase 1 of #314)
note: Separate from experiment.json on purpose: the 45-corner psrr-dc manifest and its records stay unchanged (Phase 3 of #314 decides whether the binding point becomes a leg there). This manifest is a SAMPLED grid: 3 corners x 3 C_eff x 3 ESR. It cannot prove the continuous-window or all-45-corner worst case. No threshold lives here; bounds stay in experiment.json / spec/target-spec.md.
corners_source: identical to experiment.json quick_subset (verified by sim/tests/test_psrr_cap_sweep.py)
esr_zero_topology: ESR 0 is NOT a small-resistance stand-in: RESR is removed and COUT's bottom plate goes straight to node 0. The nominal point is C_eff 1 uF / ESR 10 mOhm (DR-002 proposed nominal; spot-check against record 20260926-033606-4a9ec09 at tt/27C/3.3V).
seeding: Each (corner, point) is its own ngspice process built from the testbench netlist, so the .nodeset seed of #171/#179 applies fresh to both load points of every point; no state carries between points.
selection_rule: Per sub-metric: a point's value is the minimum over the 3 corners; the worst sampled point is the minimum of that over points; ties (|delta| <= 1e-6 dB) go to the lower C_eff, then the lower ESR. Any missing or non-finite cell for the metric yields NO finding (reported, never dropped).
